mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5, combined with a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5%, signals a supply-side shock and weakening economic activity, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% over three consecutive months signals entrenched inflationary pressures, which forces the Fed to maintain high interest rates and suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% over 3 months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average, combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO), indicates strong aggregate demand and economic momentum, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200k, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% in the most recent quarter signals a weakening economy, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases when GDPC1 < 1.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
